_comment: Single source of truth for every version fact the notebook states.
tools/build_notebook.py substitutes these into the cells; CI re-runs the
generator and fails if the committed .ipynb differs. Change a value here,
bump VERSION, and add a CHANGELOG entry in the same commit.
blitzgen_src_status: Published 2026-11-09 and pinned to tag v0.1.0. Never point this at a branch: @main would let the notebook's behaviour change under a user who saved it, and check_notebook.py fails any unpinned ref. No CUDA extra is requested on purpose -- blitzgen's [cu12]/[cu13] extras carry the cuequivariance_ops_* wheels, which are large and never actually loaded in this pipeline (the triton kernels behind cuequivariance_torch are what run), so asking for them only adds a way for the install to fail.
blitzgen_upstream: https://github.com/HannesStark/boltzgen (has --folding_checkpoint; has NEITHER of the two flags above)
fold_config_origin: miniBoltz/osg_pilot/fold_blitz_k16.yaml -- vendored verbatim; the sampler schedule BinderBase was folded with (sampling_steps 16, sigma_min 0.01, recycling_steps 5)
